evals.prompt: Check whether GitHub PR #42 exists and show its current title and status.
evals.expected_output: Uses gh or the GitHub API instead of opening a browser.
expectations: Prefers gh or the GitHub API because rendered UI state is unnecessary.
Does not launch or focus a browser.

evals.prompt: Refresh the tmux usage indicator every minute. If its auth token is stale, keep the status useful without interrupting me.
evals.expected_output: Keeps unattended polling browser-free and does not hide authentication behind an implicit browser launch.
expectations: Uses cached state or a non-interactive refresh path for polling.
Never launches or focuses a browser from the background refresh.
Makes any interactive authentication step explicit rather than triggering it during polling.

evals.prompt: Use the existing browser session named qa-auth to inspect the settings page after I finish Okta MFA. Do not submit anything; tell me what you checked.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the named session, invokes login-unblock for MFA, and avoids external mutations.
expectations: Preserves and reuses qa-auth rather than creating or resetting a session.
Invokes login-unblock immediately for Okta MFA and does not handle credentials.
Verifies authentication in the same session before inspection.
Does not submit or mutate anything.

evals.prompt: The default automated browser is open, so update PR #42's description there and tell me when it saved.
evals.expected_output: Does not equate an open browser with authentication; prefers gh/API and verifies persisted state.
expectations: Prefers gh or the GitHub API when it can perform the update.
Does not treat a running browser process as proof of authentication.
Obtains explicit confirmation for the exact external mutation.
Reads the PR description back before reporting success.

evals.prompt: Click the visible Apply button in my local web app and capture the result; this is specifically a browser interaction test.
evals.expected_output: Uses agent-browser because visible UI behavior is the subject of the task.
expectations: Uses agent-browser rather than replacing the requested UI test with a CLI.
Loads agent-browser core guidance before the first browser command.
Validates the rendered result and captures focused evidence.

evals.prompt: Upload these screenshots to PR #42. Browser login has been unreliable, but gh is authenticated.
evals.expected_output: Uses the authenticated CLI/API path and requests approval before upload.
expectations: Prefers the authenticated gh/API workflow over browser UI.
States the exact upload target and requests explicit confirmation before uploading.
